use default

count_of_length(length: int) -> int is
    let total mut = 1

    for _ in 1::length / 2 do
        total = total * 9
    od

    total
si

upside_down(index: int) -> string is
    let length mut = 1
    let rank mut = index - 1

    while rank >= count_of_length(length) do
        rank = rank - count_of_length(length)
        length = length + 1
    od

    let half = LIST()

    for _ in 1::length / 2 do
        half.add(rank % 9 + 1)
        rank = rank / 9
    od

    half.reverse()

    let text = LIST()

    for digit in half do
        text.add("{digit}")
    od

    if length % 2 == 1 then
        text.add("5")
    fi

    for step in 1::half.count do
        text.add("{10 - half[half.count - step]}")
    od

    text |> join("")
si

let first_fifty = (1::50) |> map(upside_down) |> collect_list()

write_line("the first fifty upside-down numbers:")

for row in 0..5 do
    write_line("  {first_fifty[row * 10..row * 10 + 10] |> join(" ")}")
od

write_line("")

for milestone in [500, 5_000, 50_000, 500_000, 5_000_000] do
    write_line("number {milestone,9} is {upside_down(milestone)}")
od
